other_conditions: Must have completed ninety days of service as a registered worker in the year
Disability must be caused by Paralysis, Leprosy, Tuberculosis (TB) or an Accident
Applicant must be registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Unregistered workers or their dependents are eligible upon production of a certificate from the builder or area inspector
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly financial assistance of ₹300 and a one‑time ex‑gratia payment up to ₹10,000, based on the percentage of disability.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
Certificate from builder or area inspector for unregistered workers
